title: devexp-standup-2026-03-18
content:
DevEx Standup notes — 2026-03-18

Attendees: Ava Martinez, Liam Chen, Priya Desai, Marco Ruiz, Sophie Kim, (notes)

1) High-level summary
- Focus this week: finalize the Python SDK 0.9.0 RC, publish updated quickstarts (python & node), and land the streaming docs refresh.
- Stretch: reduce example cold-start latency in the python-llm quickstart by tweaking init sequence and adding a warmup snippet.

2) Individual updates
- Ava M (owner)
  - Finalized release notes for SDK 0.9.0 RC. Waiting on one last compatibility patch from infra (PR 482). Drafted migration guide for users upgrading from 0.8.x -> 0.9.0.
  - Working on the "breaking changes" section to call out default timeout adjustment and new retry semantics.
  - Blocker: need confirmation from platform on whether the new streaming endpoint will be GA by next week; affects examples.

- Liam C (SDK)
  - Fixed two regression tests around function-calling behavior. Ran integration tests against hosted API and Dedicated dev pool.
  - Benchmarked tokenization/encoding path; found minor performance hit on 0.9.0 due to additional validation added — opened PR to gate validation behind an opt-in flag.
  - Action: coordinate with QA for a smoke test matrix across Python, Node, and Go SDK samples.

- Priya D (Docs)
  - Completed docs refresh for streaming responses: added examples for both SSE and chunk-based streaming, included fallback patterns when streaming is interrupted.
  - Updated quickstart walkthroughs to include environment variable patterns for private deployments and KMS hints.
  - Need a final screenshot for the Console route-level latency dashboard (Sophie to provide).

- Marco R (Samples/Quickstarts)
  - Migrated python-llm quickstart to use the new SDK client builder; added warmup helper to reduce first-token latency in notebooks.
  - Node quickstart PR is ready but depends on SDK 0.9.0 release tag.
  - Added a new minimal chat UI sample that demonstrates function calling + structured output.

- Sophie K (Developer Experience / Onboarding)
  - Instrumented quickstart analytics event (anonymous) to capture where users drop off in onboarding flow. Initial data shows most drop-offs at the API key step.
  - Drafted short checklist for Sales/SEs to run with customers when they try Private deployment quickstarts.
  - Provided the Console screenshot requested by Priya (uploaded to shared drive).

3) Blockers / Risks
- Platform confirmation pending on streaming GA schedule (Affects docs and SDK; action: Ava to follow up with Platform by EOD 2026-03-18).
- Infra PR (kernels selection change) may shift a header in the SDK handshake — Liam opened a compatibility PR but it needs infra review (DE-1423). Risk: rollers that pin older runtime versions may need a compatibility shim.
- Quickstart analytics flagged API key UX as friction point; need to decide if we add an in-page help modal or simplify step (decision EOW).

4) Decisions made
- Ship SDK 0.9.0 RC with validation opt-in flag enabled by default but with clear migration docs and migration script (Ava + Liam).
- Merge the python-llm quickstart change as soon as SDK tag exists; sample will include warmup helper and a note about production batching settings (Marco).
- Prioritize an "API key help" modal on the quickstart landing page over changing the overall auth flow for this sprint (Sophie + Priya).

5) Action items (owner, due)
- Ava: Ping Platform for streaming GA confirmation; update docs/PRs if date slips (due 2026-03-18).
- Liam: Add QA smoke test matrix and coordinate runs across SDKs (due 2026-03-20).
- Priya: Finalize streaming examples and insert Console screenshot into docs (due 2026-03-19).
- Marco: Merge python quickstart after SDK tag, publish updated GH pages (due 2026-03-19).
- Sophie: Implement API key help modal mock and share with product for sign-off (due 2026-03-19).
- Ava + Liam: Create migration script for validation opt-in -> full validation (due 2026-03-24).

6) Notes for follow-up
- Add a short "Intro to warmup" section to the performance docs referencing the quickstart pattern; link after Marco's merge.
- Track quickstart analytics for 2 weeks after changes to measure drop-off reduction.
- Consider a small FAQ in the quickstart repo for Private deployment gotchas (networking, KMS). Priya to draft initial FAQ.

7) Next standup
- Scheduled: 2026-03-25, 10:00am PT
- Tentative agenda: SDK GA checklist, quickstart analytics baseline, streaming docs GA status

Raw meeting transcript notes / snippets:
- "We should avoid surprising changes to default timeouts — callouts in the migration guide will help." — Liam
- "The warmup helper reduced notebook first-token by ~120ms in our dev pool." — Marco
- "If Platform delays streaming GA by more than a week, we ship docs with notes and a feature-flagged example." — Ava

End of file.
